text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"That weakness, though...
is what will take me to the next stage.
Telling me, 'Next time, you'll definitely be able to win.'"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"And that's how an Umadol moves forward!
To show everyone 'me at my absolute best'!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Even if things don't go as planned,
all you have to do is get back up and try again.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Everyone starts out weak. But there's really nothing to be ashamed of.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...That's not right.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: No, that's not it—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“And it's underway!
The year-end showdown here at Oi!”

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Furioso gets off to a fantastic start!
Smart Falcon pushes forward as well!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"It looks like a showdown between the two of them today!
Now, here comes a shift in the race! Smart Falcon takes the lead!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Furioso...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Funabashi will always be second-rate...?
I refuse to accept that.
I won't ever stand for such an evaluation.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
As the representative of Funabashi,
I am a strong Umamusume—one who will defeat you of the Central.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Furioso...!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“Now into the final stretch!
Smart Falcon breaks away from the lead!
Furioso gives chase with all she's got!”

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"The chasers are closing in!
—Furioso won't make it in time!
In the lead... is Smart Falcon!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: "Smart Falcon! Smart Falcon crosses the goal in 1st place!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, thanks for your support!
Falco took 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
OOOOOOOO!
Falcoooo, so cuuute!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm so happy♪
To receive such huge cheers of congratulations—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: How could it.......

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Listen up, everyone!
Falco has something she wants to say to all of you!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"I was able to stand before so many people
much sooner than I ever imagined.
...It feels like a dream."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Still, it wasn't a dream.
Because "back then" truly happened.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The day I re-examined myself! And all that time spent training my weak points!
That's why today, I will—!
(*Click*—)

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Whoaa, that speech really hits home...!
Maybe I should say that to the girls on my team too.

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
"Let's look at ourselves, improve bit by bit,
and create our future self."
...How does that sound?

text_block_list.name: Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Sounds like a good idea. Mental issues
can really take their toll, especially in the Senior Class.

text_block_list.name: Trainer B
text_block_list.text: "Even if someone shines in their Classic Year, there are those whose performance drops sharply in their Senior Year. Once everyone else matures, it's only natural that they fall behi—"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Shut the hell up............!

The new year has arrived. Happy New Year.
Starting this year, Espoir City
enters the Senior Year.
Right at the start of the new year, Espoir City called me out, saying she had "something to talk about." However—
choice_data_list: (She's been like this ever since she got here.)

text_block_list.text: I open the textbook to review the methods I've used with her so far. In times like these...
choice_data_list: (…I wonder what the right thing to do is…)

text_block_list.text:
"Channel her unyielding spirit into motivation"
"Build trust and set up an environment where she can perform"
"She loves it when you put hamburg steak in her bento"

"I want to make Espoir City stronger, and turn
her into an Umamusume who can truly acknowledge
her own strength."

"...The words scrawled in the margins
of the textbook seem to stare right back at me."
choice_data_list: ...—Hey, Espo.
...—Say, Espo.

text_block_list.text:
I don't know what the right thing to do is.
But one thing's for sure: she's holding something back.
choice_data_list: Want to step outside for a bit?
Why don't we step outside for a bit?

text_block_list.text: (Kyahaha... Waaah!)

With the shrine-visiting season still in full swing,
the shrine was bustling with worshipers.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...The smell of amazake...
choice_data_list: Want something to drink?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Nothing at all!

She maintains her usual rebellious attitude,
but her voice has grown much louder than before.

It might not be a bad idea to continue taking a break like this.
With that in mind...
choice_data_list: I'll go get some amazake, then.
Then I'll go get some amazake.
Want to compete with fortune slips?
Alright, let's hit the beach or something!
Alright, wanna head to the beach or something?

text_block_list.text:
It might not be a bad idea to continue taking a break like this.
With that in mind...
choice_data_list: I'll go get some amazake, then.
Then I'll go get some amazake.
Want to compete with fortune slips?
Alright, let's hit the beach or something!
Alright, wanna head to the beach or something?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: It's not really like that...
choice_data_list: Yeah, so just my share.
Yeah, that's why just for my portion.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh? Just you?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"That's... so unfair!
If you're gonna drink it, then I will too!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
H-Hold up! ...Don't run away!
Dammit... Buy me lunch firstーー!

"And while we were doing that,
we ended up making it all the way back to Tracen Academy."

She suddenly starts checking something.
...It looks like she's searching her clothes to see
if she has any spare change.
choice_data_list: I'll cover a hundred yen or so.
I'll pay for a hundred yen or so.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Wh-what...?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Nngh, I'll pay you right back!
As soon as we get back to the academy! Right away!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Don't you dare go thinking
you owe me one, you hear?!

"And while we were doing that,
we ended up making it all the way back to Tracen Academy."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: You don't like the sea?
You don't like the sea?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: It's not really like that—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...I don't want to. Not right now.
choice_data_list: ...I see.
...I see.

text_block_list.text:
With her looking away,
I had no idea what was on her mind.
"And yet, I find myself praying... hoping it might lighten her heart even a little."

"And while we were doing that,
we ended up making it all the way back to Tracen Academy."
"...I wonder if an outing like this was really alright. If only I could've thought of something better—"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text: —Espo?

I follow her gaze. Standing there
was someone who shouldn't have been at the academy.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Whyyy...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Why the hell are you here...!
Right here...!

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text: ...I only came because I was called. They said they wanted my opinion as the representative of the training club.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
What about you? Are you doing what you're supposed to?
Like—

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Admit to yourself first that you're weak!
—Otherwise, you won't ever get any stronger!!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh!

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text: Hey! Espo!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: (...Am I really okay with just being called "weak"?)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: (...There's just no way that's true...!)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: (I didn't want Mom to be hospitalized. I was lonely, I wanted to be with her.)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(I wanted Dad to believe in me.
I wanted him to praise me in front of everyone,
...and say that his child is strong.)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —With me being so weak.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
There's no way in hell...
I could be satisfied being that weak...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: And to think I was the one who never made Mom worry!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
And to think that I was the one who didn't back down to her
and chose the path of racing...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Like making mistakes... or failing...
There's no way acting weak was ever the right call...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —...There's no way in hell...!
